requirement.label: Honors Program
requirement.notes: Students must take one theory course from English 120 through 128 no later than winter quarter of the junior year. In spring quarter of the junior year, students must take course 191H. During fall and winter quarters of the senior year, students must take courses 198A and 198B, in which they write a thesis under the direction of a faculty member.
